summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of Plotto Navigator. Backend: 33 pytest tests across plotto reference data, auth/captcha, bookmarks and saved plots (32 pass, 1 fail). Frontend: landing, browse (category filter, search, pagination), conflict detail + cross-reference navigation, register/login with captcha, bookmarks, A/B/C clauses, character symbols, plot builder (clause selects, skeleton preview, reorder, notes, save), library (list/edit/delete), protected routes, logout and mobile viewport — all core flows work. One real backend bug found in the brute-force lockout path (HTTP 500) plus an ineffective lockout key behind the ingress.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout path returns 500 Internal Server Error instead of 429. auth.py:144 compares `locked_until` (stored as naive datetime by Mongo) with `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` -> TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes. Reproduced on localhost:8001: attempts 1-5 -> 401, attempts 6+ -> 500, and a subsequent login with the CORRECT password also returns 500 for the whole 15-min window, so the account is unusable with an opaque 500. Fix: store/compare tz-aware (e.g. `locked_until.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)`).

minor.issue: Lockout identifier is `f"{client_ip}:{email}"`, but behind the k8s ingress the observed client IP rotates (login_attempts showed 10.49.139.198 count=4 and 10.49.139.196 count=3 for the same email/attack). Counts get split so the 5-attempt threshold is never reached via the public URL — brute-force protection is effectively disabled in production. Recommend keying on email (optionally + X-Forwarded-For).
Uses deprecated FastAPI `@app.on_event("startup"/"shutdown")`; migrate to the lifespan context manager.

integration_issues.issue: Captcha is fetched twice on mount (React StrictMode double-effect). The visible question can be replaced ~1-2s after the form renders and the answer field is reset, so a fast user who answers the first question gets 'Incorrect captcha answer.' Reproduced once (typed answer for 'What is 6 + 6?', submission failed and the widget then showed 'What is 8 + 4?'). Dev/StrictMode-only, low priority, but a mount guard/AbortController in Captcha.js would remove the race.

issues: Category filter rail is `hidden lg:block` with no mobile/tablet alternative (no drawer/select), so category and subcategory filtering is completely unavailable below 1024px. Search still works. No horizontal overflow observed; mobile menu open/close works.

action_items: CRITICAL: fix naive/aware datetime comparison in auth.py login lockout check (currently 500s and blocks a valid password for 15 minutes).
Key the login lockout on email (not proxy IP) so the 5-attempt rule actually triggers behind the ingress.
Optional: guard Captcha.js against the StrictMode double fetch (mount flag / AbortController) so the visible challenge does not change after render.
Optional: add a mobile/tablet category filter (drawer or select) to Browse.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py:144 — `locked_until > datetime.now(timezone.utc)` on a value read back from Mongo (naive) raises TypeError and surfaces as an unhandled 500; normalise tzinfo on read.
auth.py:139-140 — lockout identifier derived from `request.client.host`; behind ingress this is a rotating pod/proxy IP, defeating rate limiting.

Verified good: bcrypt hashes are $2b$, httpOnly+secure cookies set on login, CORS uses explicit origins from env with credentials, plots/bookmarks are strictly user-scoped (cross-user GET/PUT/DELETE all 404), no MongoDB _id leaks, seed_admin re-hashes when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -q). Only TestAuth::test_brute_force_lockout fails, and it fails on purpose: it asserts no 500 in the lockout sequence (hits localhost:8001 directly because the public ingress rotates client IPs). Frontend testids for clauses are clause-<field>-<n> / use-clause-<field>-<n> where field = a_clause|b_clause|c_clause (NOT a|b|c as in the request doc); Browse pagination controls only render when pages > 1 (search 'jealous' = 8 results so no pagination — not a bug). Logout navigates to '/' (Landing) so sidebar-login-button is absent there; protected routes correctly redirect to /login.
rca_of_the_issue: Motor/PyMongo returns BSON dates as naive datetimes. login_attempts.locked_until is written as an aware UTC datetime but read back naive, so `locked_until > datetime.now(timezone.utc)` in the lockout guard raises TypeError, producing a 500 for every login attempt (right or wrong password) for that identifier until the record's 15-minute window passes. Reproduction: register a user, POST /api/auth/login 6 times with a wrong password against http://localhost:8001 -> 401 x5 then 500; a 7th attempt with the correct password also returns 500.
